newsitem.title: USA: Flushing says to buy N.Y. Federal Savings.
newsitem.headline: Flushing says to buy N.Y. Federal Savings.

text.p: Flushing Financial Corp said Friday it will acquire the privately held New York Federal Savings Bank for about $13 million including common stock, options and payment to preferred shareholders.

The company said the deal is expected to close in the third quarter of 1997. It will be accounted for as a purchase transaction, and is expected to be accretive to its GAAP and cash earings per share.
The company said the acquistion will increase its assets to $849 million.
